'''Breathing tubes''' were designed to help individuals with breathing, as well as survive in harsh environments, such as [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. A notable user of breathing tubes was the notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].
